extDescription.message: Page summary, quick on-page audit and “Send to OpenGSC” for the page you are on.

needConfigure.message: Set your OpenGSC instance URL and token first.

unsupportedPage.message: This page cannot be audited (browser-internal or non-http page).

specialNote.message: This is a Google tool page — OpenGSC does not parse it. The data behind it is already in OpenGSC through the API.

sendWaiting.message: The summary has not answered yet — try again in a moment.

notInPortfolio.message: This URL does not belong to any site in the portfolio.

noMetrics.message: No clicks or impressions in the last {n} days.

indexUnknownTitle.message: Never checked, or Google returned a state this version does not recognize

auditUnavailable.message: The quick audit could not run on this page.

notMigrated.message: The server needs `npx prisma db push` — ask the instance owner.

sentQueued.message: Queued — Google index check will run on the next tick.

sentProspect.message: Saved to Outreach as a new prospect.

sentProspectExisting.message: Already in Outreach — existing prospect returned.

sendReason_not_in_portfolio.message: This URL is not a portfolio page.

sendReason_auto_check_off.message: Auto index-check is off for this site — enable it in the site's Indexing tab.

sendReason_not_in_inventory.message: This URL is not in the sitemap inventory.

sendReason_own_site.message: This is your own site — it goes to the index queue, not Outreach.

errAuth.message: Token rejected (401). Create or rotate it in Settings → Browser extension.

errOrigin.message: This extension's ID is not allowed (403). Add it in Settings → Browser extension → Allowed extension IDs.

errNetwork.message: Cannot reach {url} — check the instance URL in options.

optionsIntro.message: Point the extension at your self-hosted OpenGSC instance.

optionsTestHint.message: The test opens one free request: it proves the URL, the token and the extension-ID allowlist together.

optionsCorsHint.message: Copy this ID into OpenGSC → Settings → Browser extension → Allowed extension IDs. Requests are rejected with 403 until it is listed.

optionsPrivacyText.message: Only what you click: the page URL for the summary and for “Send to OpenGSC”, and the token. The quick audit is computed inside the browser and never leaves it.

optionsErrToken.message: The token starts with ogscext_ — copy it from Settings → Browser extension.

optionsSavedNoHost.message: Saved (host permission declined — requests rely on the server's CORS headers)

optionsErrFillFirst.message: Save the URL and token first.

optionsTestOk.message: OK — connection, token and allowlist all work.

optionsTest403.message: 403: this extension ID is not on the allowlist.

optionsTestNetwork.message: No answer — wrong URL or server down.
